title: 第10章 白龙血第11章 帝晶
slug: 我的灵根等级怎么是负的
content_zh:
丹渊感到无比羞愧，他虽然是真武境五重的武者，但他还是对沉翔的实力感到敬畏。丹渊现在明白了沉翔为什么会惹出这么多麻烦，成为闹事的中心，千万颗晶石都是因为他如此肆无忌惮而献上的。
“师弟，我知道这一点！傲剑宗就是一帮软蛋，虽然骄傲无比，但只知道吹牛！”
丹渊说道，他在这里呆了很多年，对于傲剑宗他有着很深的了解。
处理完魔阳族之后，沉翔并没有立即离开，他还在等待丹元恢复过来，然后他才会离开。这将阻止矿井再次受到攻击。
虽然住在山洞里，但冷幽兰却一点也不介意。她的独处生存能力很强，这也是她没有像其他女孩一样厌恶这样的环境的原因之一。更何况，她还能整天跟在哥哥身边，这就是她最开心的事情了。
“兄弟，你给我的果实真是厉害，我还没炼化完呢！”
冷幽兰躺在沉翔的怀里，她非常喜欢这种舒服的感觉。沉翔也喜欢搂着她，抚摸着她柔软美丽的白发。
沉翔笑道：“你能炼成这样，那就更厉害了！哦，对了。幽兰，你想知道你走后，我是怎么教训那太子的吗？”
“我愿意！”
冷幽兰兴奋的说道。虽然她也听说过一些关于世俗的事情，但是却没有那么详细。
沉翔非常耐心地讲述了冷幽兰离开后他所做的那些令人震惊的事情。他相信，作为一个哥哥，他必须在妹妹眼中树立一个高大威猛的形象。这也能避免冷幽兰总以为自己比他强。
一直聊到晚上，冷幽兰依然没有离开。沉翔躺在床上，她搂着他，听着沉翔的吹牛，她笑得甜甜的。
时间一点点过去，冷幽兰终于在沉翔身边睡着了。看到冷幽兰那甜甜的笑容，沉翔悄悄在她脸颊上亲了一下。
“我的好兄弟，你从一开始就把她当成妹妹，是不怀好意的！”
苏媚瑶娇嗔道。紧接着就是白幽幽的冷骂声。
“走开，别胡思乱想！”
陈翔说道。
“切，你躺在床上抱着她，你也不想别人的思绪跑错了吧！”
苏媚瑶啧了一声，反驳道。
“就是啊，你竟然和一个女孩子同床共枕！真是卑鄙，哼！”

白悠悠冷哼一声。
沉翔顽皮地笑道：“你们两个就是嫉妒啊！天天看着我洗澡，我也不说话，现在我和结拜姐姐在一起了，还白白骂我呢。”
“谁看你了！”
苏媚瑶羞涩的反驳道。不过，她的声音很低，白幽幽也不再说话了。
沉翔调皮地笑道：“你见过我没穿衣服，我也见过你赤身裸体，就好像我们是在谈恋爱吧？嘿嘿……我不想让别人的心思走错路。”尤其是你，你已经在我赤身裸体的时候偷看了我千百遍了！”
“哼！”
苏媚瑶和白幽幽同时娇哼一声。到了这个地步，他们就迫不及待地想找个地洞，把头藏起来。本来，他们并不想让沉翔知道他们一直在偷看他。谁料最后关头却吵醒了沉翔，并且偷听了他们的谈话。也正是靠着这一次的运气，他才知道了他们的耻辱。
沉翔得意地笑起来。
“沉翔，我也经常看到你洗澡！你的样子一点也不好看，也没有两姐妹换衣服时的吸引力了。”
龙雪怡打断道。
这让沉翔的脸色顿时绿了，苏媚瑶和白幽幽更是无语了。他们显然知道龙雪怡的神念极强，竟然能够穿透戒指内部，看到他们。虽然被一个小女孩看到，但心里或多或少有些不舒服。
“真接近音调就黑了，媚瑶姐，悠悠姐，你们看看你们干的好事！还教坏了这个小丫头！”
content_en:
Dan Yuan felt extremely ashamed. Although he was a warrior at the fifth level of the True Martial Realm, he was still in awe of Chen Xiang's strength. Dan Yuan now understood why Chen Xiang caused so much trouble and became the center of trouble. Tens of millions of crystals were donated because of his unscrupulousness.
"Junior brother, I know this! The Proud Sword Sect is a bunch of cowards. Although they are extremely proud, they only know how to brag!"
Dan Yuan said that he had stayed here for many years and had a deep understanding of the Proud Sword Sect.
After dealing with the Mo Yang clan, Chen Xiang did not leave immediately. He was still waiting for the Dan Yuan to recover before he left. This will prevent the mine from being attacked again.
Although she lives in a cave, Leng Youlan doesn't mind at all. She has a strong ability to survive alone, which is one of the reasons why she doesn't hate such an environment like other girls. What's more, she can stay with her brother all day long, which is the happiest thing for her.
"Brother, the fruit you gave me is really powerful, I haven't finished refining it yet!"
Leng Youlan was lying in Chen Xiang's arms. She liked this comfortable feeling very much. Chen Xiang also liked to hug her and stroke her soft and beautiful white hair.
Chen Xiang smiled and said: "If you can practice like this, you will be even more powerful! Oh, by the way. Youlan, do you want to know how I taught the prince a lesson after you left?"
"I do!"
Leng Youlan said excitedly. Although she had heard some things about the world, but not in so much detail.
Chen Xiang very patiently told the shocking things he did after Leng Youlan left. He believes that as an older brother, he must establish a tall and powerful image in the eyes of his sister. This can also prevent Leng Youlan from always thinking that she is better than him.
After chatting until night, Leng Youlan still didn't leave. Chen Xiang was lying on the bed, she hugged him, listening to Chen Xiang's bragging, she smiled sweetly.
Time passed little by little, and Leng Youlan finally fell asleep next to Chen Xiang. Seeing Leng Youlan's sweet smile, Chen Xiang secretly kissed her on the cheek.
"My good brother, you have bad intentions in treating her as your sister from the beginning!"
Su Meiyao said angrily. This was followed by Bai Youyou's cold scolding.
"Go away and stop thinking!"
Chen Xiang said.
"Tch, you lie on the bed and hold her, you don't want other people's thoughts to go astray, right?"
Su Meiyao clicked her tongue and retorted.
"That's right, you actually slept with a girl! How despicable, huh!"
Bai Youyou snorted coldly.
Chen Xiang smiled mischievously and said, "You two are just jealous! You watch me take a shower every day and I don't say anything. Now that I'm with my sworn sister, you're still scolding me for nothing."
"Who's looking at you!"
Su Meiyao retorted shyly. However, her voice was very low, and Bai Youyou stopped talking.
Chen Xiang smiled mischievously: "You have seen me without clothes, and I have seen you naked, as if we are in love, right? Hehe... I don't want other people's minds to go astray." Especially you, you have peeked at me thousands of times when I was naked! "
"snort! "
Su Meiyao and Bai Youyou snorted at the same time. At this point, they can't wait to find a hole in the ground and hide their heads. Originally, they didn't want Chen Xiang to know that they had been peeking at him. Unexpectedly, Chen Xiang woke up at the last moment and overheard their conversation. It was through this luck that he learned about their shame.
Chen Xiang smiled proudly.
"Chen Xiang, I often see you taking a shower! You don't look good at all, and you're not as attractive as the two sisters were when they were changing clothes. "
Long Xueyi interrupted.
This made Chen Xiang's face suddenly turn green, and Su Meiyao and Bai Youyou were speechless. They obviously knew that Long Xueyi's spiritual sense was so strong that she could penetrate the inside of the ring and see them. Although being watched by a little girlI arrived, but I felt more or less uncomfortable.
"It's so close that the tone turns dark. Sister Meiyao, Sister Youyou, look at the good things you have done! You even taught this little girl a bad lesson!"
